intro: Explore Benidorm at your own pace. Save your plans, favourites and holiday spending on your device.

areas.name: Levante Beach
areas.description: Popular eastern beach with a long promenade, cafes and a lively atmosphere.

areas.name: Poniente Beach
areas.description: Wide western beach and promenade, often a quieter choice for a stroll.

areas.name: Old Town
areas.description: Winding streets, shops and traditional places to eat between the two main beaches.

areas.name: Balcón del Mediterráneo
areas.description: Scenic viewpoint between Levante and Poniente beaches.

areas.name: La Cala / Finestrat
areas.description: Nearby coastal area worth exploring for a change of scenery.

attractions.name: Benidorm Old Town
attractions.description: Explore the streets, viewpoints and local shops.

attractions.name: Parque de Elche
attractions.description: Seafront park near the Old Town and Poniente.

attractions.name: Serra Gelada Natural Park
attractions.description: Coastal landscape and walking routes; check trail conditions and difficulty.

attractions.name: Terra Mítica
attractions.description: Theme park; check current operating dates and tickets online.

attractions.name: Aqualandia
attractions.description: Water park; check seasonal opening before visiting.

attractions.name: Mundomar
attractions.description: Wildlife attraction; check current visitor information online.

transport.name: Walking
transport.description: Promenades and central areas are walkable; allow for hills around the Old Town.

transport.name: Local buses
transport.description: Check current routes, fares and timetables with the local operator.

transport.name: Tram
transport.description: TRAM d’Alacant serves the wider Costa Blanca; check the official timetable.

transport.name: Airport transfers
transport.description: Compare transfer options from Alicante–Elche Airport before travel.

useful.name: Emergency services
